interpretation: Mapbox chunk appears in generated HTML, which may mean it is being preloaded too early.
MapLibre chunk does not appear directly in generated HTML/modulepreload scan.
Mapbox route-only loading was not fully proven by this audit.
MapLibre appears to be referenced from JS/runtime chunks rather than directly from HTML.
If both engines are route-only loaded, the remaining warnings may be acceptable for map-heavy routes, but browser route signoff is required.

decisionOptions.label: Accept current map chunk warnings as intentional route-heavy assets
decisionOptions.recommendedWhen: Use if map chunks are not preloaded in HTML and only load when map routes need them.

decisionOptions.label: Audit runtime network loading in browser
decisionOptions.recommendedWhen: Use if static build scan is not enough to prove route-only loading.

decisionOptions.label: Plan future map-engine consolidation
decisionOptions.recommendedWhen: Use only as a later product refactor, not as a quick patch.

recommendedDecision: Run a browser network loading signoff before deciding whether more bundle tuning is needed.

nextPatchRecommendation.label: Runtime Map Loading Signoff
